entries.reason: Cooler's bounded host input protocol returns an empty String after the supplied lines are exhausted; the classic SPIM 6.5 trap handler exposes EOF as repeated 0xff bytes.
entries.evidence: The 2026-09-01 strict 90-fixture run matched the supplied integer and string inputs, then observed repeated 0xff bytes only on the final exhausted in_string call.
entries.expectedReference: A\nB/0/-42/hello/ followed by repeated 0xff bytes at EOF
entries.removalCondition: Remove when the declared host input protocol adopts the classic trap handler's EOF bytes or the reference runtime returns an empty String for this fixture.

entries.reason: Cooler rejects overflowing decimal input deterministically as 0, while the classic trap handler saturates positive and negative overflows to signed 32-bit endpoints.
entries.removalCondition: Remove if Cooler's documented input contract changes to classic saturation or the reference runtime rejects overflow as 0.

entries.reason: Cooler preserves an embedded NUL in its host String and returns empty input at EOF; the classic C-string trap handler truncates at NUL and then exposes EOF as 0xff bytes.
entries.evidence: The 2026-09-01 strict run observed Cooler [left\x00right]/[] and SPIM [left]/[ followed by repeated 0xff bytes.
entries.removalCondition: Remove if Cooler adopts NUL-terminated strings and classic EOF bytes or the reference runtime gains the declared host String behavior.

entries.reason: Cooler deliberately defines Unicode String length and substr by code point; the ASCII-era reference runtime counts and indexes UTF-8 bytes.
entries.evidence: The 2026-09-01 strict run observed Cooler 2/é/😀é and SPIM 6/\x9f/😀é for the same UTF-8 source literal.
entries.removalCondition: Remove only if the project changes its documented Unicode code-point contract or the reference runtime becomes code-point based.

entries.reason: The fixture's preloaded and reversible input is a Cooler debugger-host protocol; direct SPIM execution has no debugger replay channel and reads exhausted stdin as 0xff bytes.
entries.evidence: The 2026-09-01 strict run observed the straight-line Cooler output || and SPIM output containing repeated 0xff bytes between separators.
entries.expectedCooler: || in straight-line differential execution; debugger scenarios separately assert preloaded|| and replay
entries.expectedReference: separator-delimited repeated 0xff bytes because no debugger input channel exists
entries.removalCondition: Remove if the differential harness gains an equivalent reference debugger replay channel or the fixture stops depending on Cooler debugger input.

entries.reason: Cooler intentionally pauses this program under debugger lifecycle control; standalone SPIM has no corresponding pause protocol and continues until the containment timeout.
entries.evidence: The 2026-09-01 strict run recorded Cooler runtimeExit=paused and a contained five-second reference runtime timeout.
entries.expectedReference: reference runtime timeout without an external debugger pause protocol
entries.removalCondition: Remove if an equivalent reference debugger lifecycle adapter is added or the fixture becomes a terminating standalone program.

entries.reason: Cooler deliberately makes signed 32-bit arithmetic wrap deterministically; SPIM 6.5 raises an arithmetic-overflow exception on the first overflowing add.
entries.evidence: The 2026-09-01 strict run completed Cooler's modular boundary sequence while SPIM stopped with Exception 12 [Arithmetic overflow].
entries.expectedReference: runtime arithmetic-overflow before producing the sequence
entries.removalCondition: Remove if the documented modular arithmetic policy changes to trapping overflow or the reference execution is configured for matching wraparound.

entries.reason: Cooler's deterministic instruction budget pauses an otherwise nonterminating loop; the reference runtime has no matching host safety budget.
entries.evidence: The 2026-09-01 strict run recorded Cooler runtimeExit=paused and a contained five-second SPIM timeout.
entries.expectedCooler: paused at the configured instruction limit
entries.expectedReference: reference runtime timeout while continuing the loop
entries.removalCondition: Remove if SPIM is wrapped in a semantically equivalent instruction budget or the fixture becomes terminating.

entries.reason: Cooler's cumulative execution budget pauses the repeated run deterministically; standalone SPIM has no equivalent session-total budget.
entries.evidence: The 2026-09-01 strict run recorded Cooler runtimeExit=paused and a contained five-second reference timeout.
entries.expectedCooler: paused at the configured cumulative instruction limit
entries.expectedReference: reference runtime timeout without a cumulative host-session budget
entries.removalCondition: Remove if the reference adapter gains an equivalent cumulative budget or the fixture no longer exercises a nonterminating run.
